title: Learned items with provenance: editors read, trace, and steer what a cyclotron learned
description: Ryan committed 2026-10-21 (via the Papyrus marketing redesign). Goal: an editor reads in plain words everything a cyclotron learned; each item shows the approvals, rejections and notes behind it; every decision says which items drove it; editing, removing or adding an item changes later decisions only after held-out measurement. Plan: https://claude.ai/artifact/Jg1DpixLFcAvnPy7d9RNDE. Current state (code-checked 2026-10-21): rubric is one free-text string (classifier_config.py:28); provenance is window-level only; decisions carry no rationale; hosted steering reports steering:false; undo of a trained-on label resets all learned structure (flywheel.py:763-780).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Ryan's decisions 2026-10-21 (relayed by the Papyrus marketing redesign session, his words: 'Accept all three recommendations and pull safe undo forward'): (1) editor notes are cited evidence by default with an explicit 'make this an item' action, never auto-promoted; (2) the optimizer may propose changes to editor-written items only as candidates an editor promotes, never auto-applied; (3) clause measures come from per-item ablation on held-out labels, on demand, not every version; (4) safe undo is split out of M4 and scheduled first. M3 is split into M3a (structured items with decision-prompt equivalence, gated on an accuracy measurement) and M3b (optimizer item operations with validated citations). Papyrus counterpart epic: PPY-e3e6a5 (PPY-56237a data sync, PPY-0d0e66 version card, PPY-ad232f why this item, PPY-b87574 items list, PPY-c54ebf steer items).
